messages.author: 39f5a1aeeec9eadd
messages.subject: links as buttons
parts:
Hi all. I have an application with quite a few actionButton()s in it. I would like to replace a number of these buttons with anchor tags (<a></a>) instead, that then have exactly the same behavior as the actionButton()s. I am all but certain that this is possible (with javascript), but cannot find any threads explaining the short and sweet of how this construct is accomplished. Does anyone have a link they can share or some simple code I can work from?

Thanks,
Dan

PS I think the solution has to do with using the "name" or "id" attribute within the <a> tag and writing some javascript in the header of the app's HTML.

messages.author: 39f5a1aeeec9eadd
messages.subject: Re: links as buttons
parts:
... I should state the reason I want to do this:

because (I think) links are quicker to load, thus I figure the app can be more responsive than if buttons are used. If this is NOT the case, then I am only interested in terms of the screen real estate that links save as compared to buttons.

Thanks again.
